en.org: Vitality Design LLC (corporate number 1011003024109, Meguro, Tokyo, Japan). Our vision is to create experiences that exist only there. We connect places, people, culture and technology, and create the new experience that only a given region can give rise to. We are not a consultancy, a production company, a DX company, a hotel company or a travel company. Our role is to connect different kinds of value and create the experience itself. Our purpose is to connect the value sleeping in a region and create a new circulation between the world and the local. Every place holds culture, people, architecture, nature, craft, food and history you can meet nowhere else, but existing separately they often cannot deliver the appeal they truly hold. We connect across places, people, culture, technology, creative work, accommodation, food, movement and people from around the world, and reassemble them into a new experience. The circulation runs: places, culture, people and craft in a region → connecting each of those values → an experience that exists only there → people from around the world visit → exchange, spending and word of mouth follow → the value of the region rises → culture and livelihoods carry to the next generation → and back again to the value of the region. This is not tourism promotion, but a state where value unique to a region continues into the future through experience. What we do: DISCOVER the value that exists because of that place; CONNECT people, culture, space, region and technology that were separate; CREATE a new experience that exists only there; EVOLVE it from how people actually respond. Possibilities we can work with include a stay connecting a hotel to local culture, an immersive experience combining historic architecture and technology, a cultural experience connecting travellers to sake breweries and workshops, an experience integrating food, sound, light, projection and space, an experience staged across a whole town, an experience several local businesses take part in together, and an experience crossing local culture with creators from around the world. These are examples of what we can handle, not a service menu. We start with hospitality, inbound and Japan: starting from hotels and accommodation in Japan, working on new experiences that connect the local to the world. A hotel is not only a place to sleep; it can be the entrance to meeting a region. From inside the hotel to the street, from the street to the region. We are not a hotel-only company. On technology: technology should disappear into the experience. AI, software, AR, IoT, projection, sound and lighting are means for realising an experience, never something to display. They are used to know a place more deeply, to feel it more strongly, to connect people and place, and to stay in memory. In the longer term we are thinking toward a shared technical foundation, Experience OS, on which a different experience can be implemented in each place. This is a concept, not a finished product we offer today. Globally, we start from Japan but will connect the value held in each place — Tokyo, Kyoto, Seoul, Taipei, Bangkok, Paris, New York and beyond. We are not copying the same experience around the world; we reconnect what is already there together with the people of that place. Made locally. Connected globally. Our social impact: carry culture into the future, create new exchange in a region, create new options for the people who live there, and close the distance between the world and the local. Not only preserving culture, but letting people experience it and feel its value so that it carries into the future. The One Room Project is an experimental project at concept stage, one of the first experiments toward realising our vision, and is not Vitality Design itself. There are no proven results at this point. On partnership: Build Together. Rather than keeping everything in house, we create new experiences together with those who hold a place, carry a culture, build the technology, write the story and reach the world — hotels and accommodation, real estate companies, local businesses, craftspeople, creators, technology companies, construction firms, travel companies, cultural venues, local government and DMOs, and investors. We do not build once and stop; we shape something that lasts. Our representative does not come from the accommodation industry. He has travelled to more than 25 countries and has worked in corporate sales, new business development, equipment deployment, construction projects, partner development, process design and cost management, carrying concepts through to actually running on site. We do not present any track record in accommodation as proven at this stage, and visuals on this site are concept images, not actual completed projects. The company purpose is to move the relationship between people forward.
en.person: Shota Yamamoto does not come from the accommodation industry. He has travelled to more than 25 countries, experiencing cities, cultures, places to stay, architecture, food and the people he met. Professionally he has worked in corporate sales, new business development, equipment deployment, construction projects, partner development, process design and cost management, carrying concepts through to actually running on site.

zh.org: Vitality Design 合同会社（法人编号 1011003024109，日本东京都目黑区）。愿景是「创造只有在那里才能实现的体验」。我们连接场所、人、文化与技术，创造只有那个地域才能孕育的新体验。我们不是咨询公司、制作公司、DX 公司、酒店公司，也不是旅行社。我们的角色是连接不同的价值，并创造体验本身。使命是「连接沉睡于地域中的价值，创造世界与地域之间新的循环」。每片土地都拥有只有在那里才能遇见的文化、人、建筑、自然、技术、饮食与历史，但若只是各自分离地存在，往往无法充分传达其本来的魅力。我们横跨场所、人、文化、技术、创意、住宿、饮食、移动，以及世界各地的人们，将其重新构成为新的体验。循环的流程为：地域中的场所・文化・人・技术 → 连接各自的价值 → 只有在那里才能实现的体验 → 世界各地的人前来造访 → 产生交流、消费与传播 → 地域的价值得以提升 → 文化与营生延续至下一代 → 然后再次回到地域的价值之中。这并非单纯的观光振兴，而是让那个地域独有的价值通过体验延续到未来。我们所做的是：DISCOVER 发现只有那个场所才存在的价值；CONNECT 连接原本分离的人、文化、空间、地域与技术；CREATE 创造只有在那个场所才能实现的新体验；EVOLVE 依据真实的反应培育体验。可能的形态包括：连接酒店与地域文化的住宿体验、结合历史建筑与技术的沉浸式体验、连接酒窖与工坊与旅行者的文化体验、整合饮食与声音与光与影像与空间的体验、以整个街区为舞台的体验、由多家地域事业者共同参与的体验，以及将世界各地创作者与地域文化相结合的体验。这些是我们能够处理的可能性示例，并非服务清单。当前的起点是住宿・入境・日本：以日本的酒店与住宿设施为起点，打造连接地域与世界的新体验。酒店不只是住宿之处，它可以成为与这片地域相遇的入口。从酒店之中走向街区，从街区走向地域。我们并非酒店专门公司。关于技术：技术应当消融于体验之中。AI、软件、AR、IoT、影像、音响、照明都是实现体验的手段，而非用来展示的对象。它们的用途是：更深入地了解那个场所、更强烈地感受、连接人与场所、留在记忆之中。长远来看，我们正朝着构建共通技术基础（Experience OS）的方向思考，使各场所不同的体验能够在同一机制上实现。这是构想，而非目前已作为成品提供的产品。在全球层面，我们从日本开始，但将连接东京、京都、首尔、台北、曼谷、巴黎、纽约等各地所拥有的价值。我们不是把同一种体验复制到世界各地，而是将那片土地原有的东西，与当地的人们一起重新连接。Made locally. Connected globally.社会意义在于：将文化连接至未来、在地域中产生新的交流、为当地的人们创造新的选择、拉近世界与地域之间的距离。不只是保存文化，而是让人去体验、去感受其价值，从而留存至未来。One Room Project 是处于概念阶段的实验项目，是为实现愿景而进行的最初实验之一，并非 Vitality Design 本身。现阶段没有已验证的成果。关于合作：Build Together。我们并非将一切都揽在自己手中，而是与拥有场所的人、承继文化的人、创造技术的人、创作故事的人、把它传向世界的人一起创造新的体验——包括酒店与住宿设施、不动产公司、地域企业、匠人、创作者、技术企业、施工公司、旅行社、文化设施、地方政府与 DMO，以及投资方。我们不是做完一次就结束，而是打造能够延续的形态。公司代表并非出身住宿行业。他曾走访 25 个以上国家，并从事过企业销售、新事业、设备导入、施工项目、合作伙伴开拓、业务设计与成本管理，一直负责到让构想在现场真正运转为止。住宿领域的实绩目前并不作为已验证的内容呈现，本网站上的视觉为概念示意图，并非实际已完成的项目。企业的 Purpose 是「让人与人的关系向前」。
zh.person: 山本翔太并非出身住宿行业。他曾走访 25 个以上国家，体验过各地的城市、文化、住宿、建筑、饮食与人的相遇。在工作上，曾从事企业销售、新事业、设备导入、施工项目、合作伙伴开拓、业务设计与成本管理，并一直负责到让构想在现场真正运转为止。
